correctness.rationale: Strict pushout is justified by the compact Hausdorff quotient and the cofibration boundary leg. The symmetric-circle multiplication map is a homotopy equivalence by both the disk-bundle theorem and the polynomial-coefficient homotopy proof in the result. With proper fundamental-group maps, van Kampen yields simple connectivity, a unimodular Mayer--Vietoris matrix gives integral \(H_3\cong\mathbb Z\) only, and CW-type Whitehead yields Y_p homotopy equivalent to \(S^3\). Minimal-nonface components give the full wreath-product automorphism group, and coordinatewise homotopy equivalence yields the symmetric product factors. Rational cohomology uses the correct sign in exterior tensor factors. verify.py performed sample checks for the critical matrix, small automorphism groups and rational invariants; its finite cases do not prove the uniform theorem.

value.rationale: The classification is a natural integral homotopy-type formula for every partition-matroid independence complex and its full combinatorial symmetry group; repeated block sizes produce finite symmetric powers and singleton blocks vanish, with no artificial numerical cutoff. Rational cohomology simplifies to an exterior ring on distinct block-size classes. The pushout calculation reveals the topology of a nonfree quotient beyond already available nonequivariant Betti computations and supports natural future investigation of integral torsion in these symmetric powers.
